name: Blinkit
one_liner: Blinkit delivers groceries and everyday essentials to consumers in 8 minutes.
what_you_sell: Grocery and everyday essential products delivered to doorsteps within 8 minutes.
target_group: Individual consumers and households located near Blinkit fulfillment centers who need quick delivery of groceries and household items. A good prospect is anyone located in a supported area who prefers instant delivery over visiting local retail stores.
who_uses_it: Individual consumers ordering groceries and household items online.
who_pays_for_it: Individual consumers paying for their grocery orders and delivery.
who_buys_it: Individual consumers and households located within delivery zones.
_note: Fill in sender and cannot_claim, then set reviewed to true. Nothing downstream will run until you do. See _claims_to_check for what the tool noticed your site implies.
